R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsMachineRow:
import R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsMachine
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsMachineRow
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

def digit (j : Usize) (count : U32) : Usize := Usize.wrapping_shr j count &&& 3#usize

theorem or_value (a b : Usize) : (a ||| b).val = a.val ||| b.val := by
  change (a.bv ||| b.bv).toNat = _
  exact BitVec.toNat_or _ _

theorem digit_value (j : Usize) (count : U32) (hc : count.val < 10) :
    (digit j count).val = (j.val >>> count.val) &&& 3 := by
  change ((Usize.wrapping_shr j count).bv &&& (3#usize).bv).toNat = _
  rw [BitVec.toNat_and]
  change (Usize.wrapping_shr j count).val &&& 3 = _
  rw [PV_CB3_WeightsMachine.shift_right j count hc,Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]

theorem digit_bound (j : Usize) (count : U32) (hc : count.val < 10) :
    (digit j count).val < 4 := by
  rw [digit_value j count hc]
  have h : (j.val >>> count.val) &&& 3 ≤ 3 := Nat.and_le_right
  omega

def row (j : Usize) : Usize :=
  ((((Usize.wrapping_shl (digit j 0#u32) 6#u32) |||
      (Usize.wrapping_shl (digit j 2#u32) 8#u32)) |||
      (Usize.wrapping_shl (digit j 4#u32) 4#u32)) ||| digit j 6#u32) |||
      (Usize.wrapping_shl (digit j 8#u32) 2#u32)

theorem row_value (j : Usize) : (row j).val = PV_CB3_WeightsBits.row j.val := by
  unfold row
  simp only [or_value]
  rw [PV_CB3_WeightsMachine.shift_left _ _ (digit_bound j 0#u32 (by decide)) (by decide),
    PV_CB3_WeightsMachine.shift_left _ _ (digit_bound j 2#u32 (by decide)) (by decide),
    PV_CB3_WeightsMachine.shift_left _ _ (digit_bound j 4#u32 (by decide)) (by decide),
    PV_CB3_WeightsMachine.shift_left _ _ (digit_bound j 8#u32 (by decide)) (by decide)]
  rw [digit_value j 0#u32 (by decide),digit_value j 2#u32 (by decide),
    digit_value j 4#u32 (by decide),digit_value j 6#u32 (by decide),digit_value j 8#u32 (by decide)]
  simp only [PV_CB3_WeightsBits.row,PV_CB3_WeightsBits.digit,Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
  have h0 : (0#u32).val = 0 := rfl
  have h2 : (2#u32).val = 2 := rfl
  have h4 : (4#u32).val = 4 := rfl
  have h6 : (6#u32).val = 6 := rfl
  have h8 : (8#u32).val = 8 := rfl
  simp only [h0,h2,h4,h6,h8,Nat.reduceMul]

/-- No restriction on j is needed for the two S permutation variants. -/
theorem row_bound (j : Usize) : (row j).val < 1024 := by
  rw [row_value]
  exact PV_CB3_WeightsBits.row_bound _
#print axioms or_value
#print axioms digit_value
#print axioms digit_bound
#print axioms row_value
#print axioms row_bound
end R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsMachineRow
R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsMachine:
import R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsBits
import Aeneas
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsMachine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

theorem width_min : 32 ≤ UScalarTy.numBits .Usize := by
  rcases System.Platform.numBits_eq with h|h <;> simp [UScalarTy.numBits,h]

theorem cast_count (x : Usize) (h : x.val < 32) :
    (UScalar.cast .U32 x).val = x.val := by
  change (BitVec.zeroExtend 32 x.bv).toNat = _
  rw [BitVec.zeroExtend_eq_setWidth,BitVec.toNat_setWidth]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by change x.val < 4294967296; omega)

theorem shift_left (x : Usize) (count : U32) (hx : x.val < 4) (hc : count.val ≤ 8) :
    (Usize.wrapping_shl x count).val = x.val * 2^count.val := by
  change (x.val <<< (count.val % UScalarTy.numBits .Usize)) % 2^(UScalarTy.numBits .Usize) = _
  have hw := width_min
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : count.val < UScalarTy.numBits .Usize),Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
  have hb := PV_CB3_WeightsBits.shifted_bound x.val count.val hx hc
  rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq] at hb
  have hp : 2^10 ≤ 2^(UScalarTy.numBits .Usize) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hb hp)

theorem shift_right (x : Usize) (count : U32) (hc : count.val < 10) :
    (Usize.wrapping_shr x count).val = x.val / 2^count.val := by
  change (x.val >>> (count.val % UScalarTy.numBits .Usize)) = _
  have hw := width_min
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : count.val < UScalarTy.numBits .Usize),Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
#print axioms width_min
#print axioms cast_count
#print axioms shift_left
#print axioms shift_right
end R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsMachine
R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsBits:
import R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsDomain
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsBits

def digit (j d : Nat) : Nat := (j >>> (2*d)) &&& 3

theorem digit_bound (j d : Nat) : digit j d < 4 := by
  have h : (j >>> (2*d)) &&& 3 ≤ 3 := Nat.and_le_right
  unfold digit
  omega

theorem shifted_bound (x n : Nat) (hx : x < 4) (hn : n ≤ 8) : x <<< n < 2^10 := by
  rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
  have hp : 2^n ≤ 2^8 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hn
  have hpos := Nat.two_pow_pos n
  have hmul := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hx hpos
  omega

def row (j : Nat) : Nat :=
  ((((digit j 0 <<< 6) ||| (digit j 1 <<< 8)) ||| (digit j 2 <<< 4)) ||| digit j 3) |||
    (digit j 4 <<< 2)

theorem row_bound (j : Nat) : row j < 1024 := by
  unfold row
  change _ < 2^10
  apply Nat.or_lt_two_pow
  · apply Nat.or_lt_two_pow
    · apply Nat.or_lt_two_pow
      · exact Nat.or_lt_two_pow (shifted_bound _ _ (digit_bound j 0) (by decide))
          (shifted_bound _ _ (digit_bound j 1) (by decide))
      · exact shifted_bound _ _ (digit_bound j 2) (by decide)
    · have h := digit_bound j 3; omega
  · exact shifted_bound _ _ (digit_bound j 4) (by decide)

theorem digit_value (j d : Nat) : digit j d = PV_CB3_WeightsDomain.digit j d := by
  unfold digit PV_CB3_WeightsDomain.digit
  rw [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  have hp : 2^(2*d) = 4^d := by rw [Nat.pow_mul]
  rw [hp]
  exact Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod _ 2
#print axioms digit_bound
#print axioms shifted_bound
#print axioms row_bound
#print axioms digit_value
end R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsBits
R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsDomain:
import Std
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsDomain

def digit (j d : Nat) : Nat := (j / 4^d) % 4

def row (j : Nat) : Nat :=
  digit j 0 * 64 + digit j 1 * 256 + digit j 2 * 16 + digit j 3 + digit j 4 * 4

theorem digit_bound (j d : Nat) : digit j d < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)

/-- Both S variants discard all bits above their five base-four digits. -/
theorem row_bound (j : Nat) : row j < 1024 := by
  have h0 := digit_bound j 0
  have h1 := digit_bound j 1
  have h2 := digit_bound j 2
  have h3 := digit_bound j 3
  have h4 := digit_bound j 4
  unfold row
  omega

def CanonicalIndex (kind j : Nat) : Prop := kind < 7 ∧ j < 1024

theorem tensor_index (kind : Nat) (hlo : 1 ≤ kind) (hhi : kind < 7) (h4 : kind ≠ 4) :
    (if kind < 4 then kind-1 else kind-2) < 5 := by
  split <;> omega

theorem extra_index (j : Nat) (h : j < 56) : j / 28 < 2 := by omega

theorem exponent_bound (j : Nat) : j % 28 < 28 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)

theorem dense_index (kind b : Nat) (hk : 1 ≤ kind ∧ kind ≤ 3) (hb : b < 10) :
    kind-1 < 3 ∧ 9-b < 10 := by omega
#print axioms digit_bound
#print axioms row_bound
#print axioms tensor_index
#print axioms extra_index
#print axioms exponent_bound
#print axioms dense_index
end R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsDomain
R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsPermutation:
import R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsBits
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsPermutation

def pack (a b c d e : Nat) : Nat :=
  (e <<< 8) ||| ((d <<< 6) ||| ((c <<< 4) ||| ((b <<< 2) ||| a)))

theorem pack_value (a b c d e : Nat) (ha : a < 4) (hb : b < 4) (hc : c < 4)
    (hd : d < 4) (he : e < 4) :
    pack a b c d e = a+4*b+16*c+64*d+256*e := by
  have h0 : (b <<< 2) ||| a = 4*b+a := by
    rw [←Nat.shiftLeft_add_eq_or_of_lt (by omega : a < 2^2),Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
    omega
  have h1 : (c <<< 4) ||| ((b <<< 2) ||| a) = 16*c+(4*b+a) := by
    rw [h0,←Nat.shiftLeft_add_eq_or_of_lt (by omega : 4*b+a < 2^4),Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
    omega
  have h2 : (d <<< 6) ||| ((c <<< 4) ||| ((b <<< 2) ||| a)) = 64*d+(16*c+(4*b+a)) := by
    rw [h1,←Nat.shiftLeft_add_eq_or_of_lt (by omega : 16*c+(4*b+a) < 2^6),Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
    omega
  unfold pack
  rw [h2,←Nat.shiftLeft_add_eq_or_of_lt (by omega : 64*d+(16*c+(4*b+a)) < 2^8),Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
  omega

theorem row_value (j : Nat) : PV_CB3_WeightsBits.row j = PV_CB3_WeightsDomain.row j := by
  have hpack : PV_CB3_WeightsBits.row j = pack
      (PV_CB3_WeightsBits.digit j 3) (PV_CB3_WeightsBits.digit j 4)
      (PV_CB3_WeightsBits.digit j 2) (PV_CB3_WeightsBits.digit j 0)
      (PV_CB3_WeightsBits.digit j 1) := by
    unfold PV_CB3_WeightsBits.row pack
    ac_rfl
  rw [hpack,pack_value _ _ _ _ _ (PV_CB3_WeightsBits.digit_bound _ _)
    (PV_CB3_WeightsBits.digit_bound _ _) (PV_CB3_WeightsBits.digit_bound _ _)
    (PV_CB3_WeightsBits.digit_bound _ _) (PV_CB3_WeightsBits.digit_bound _ _)]
  simp only [PV_CB3_WeightsBits.digit_value,PV_CB3_WeightsDomain.row]
  omega
#print axioms pack_value
#print axioms row_value
end R1Z.PV_CB3_WeightsPermutation
